summary: Jedan vendored set (dmp_midi, MIT): 468 drum-machine patterna iz knjiga '200 Drum Machine Patterns' i '260 Drum Machine Patterns' (Rene-Pierre Bardet), plus LICENSE/README/input-README. Pattern korpus je integrisan kroz novi stdlib modul dna_midi_studio/pattern_library.py (normalizacija, statistika, GM role, tacno prepoznavanje redova), bez ikakvog kopiranja koda koji zahteva mido/torch/druge zavisnosti.

derivedEvidence.artifacts-max-4.64/dmp-library-stats.jso: agregatna statistika korpusa (468 patterna; 4/4:429, 12/8:30, 3/4:9; 16-step:390, 12-step:78; hit-ovi po delu; digest)
derivedEvidence.artifacts-max-4.64/dmp-patterns-normaliz: kompletna normalizovana biblioteka (468 patterna, kanonske 1/0 step linije, GM note, role, accent linije, per-pattern digesti)
derivedEvidence.artifacts-max-4.64/dmp-pattern-matches-d: probe na nasim fajlovima: reference-style kick linija == Rock1MeasureB/Rock7; fixture snare == Rock4MeasureB/Rhythm&Blues2MeasureB/Pop11 itd.
